name: OpenStreetMap offshore wind source feature collection
abstract: Source-aligned profile of the supplied Polish Baltic offshore wind GeoJSON snapshot dated 2026-10-27. It preserves OSM node, way, and relation types, numeric OSM identifiers, raw tags, relation members, supplied GeoJSON geometry including null, and source attribution.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap elements: nodes, ways, and relations

transforms.description: Converts an OSM API 0.6 map response into windfarm designated areas (`common-windfarm-designated-area`). The transformation is driven by the alignment declared in this block's `ontology.ttl`: `osmdata:WindfarmElement` selects wind farm ways and relations, and `osmdata:windfarmTagMappings` maps OSM tags onto `owf:` properties with their value conversions. A wind farm relation is merged with its outer and same-name ways, which become `same_as` links. Geometry comes from the area way, with `area_sqkm` computed geodesically. Turbines and other devices are not output.

description:
# OpenStreetMap offshore wind source data

This block describes the unconverted JSON response of the OpenStreetMap API 0.6 map endpoint (`/api/0.6/map.json?bbox=…`) for the Polish Baltic offshore wind extent, retrieved on 2026-10-27. It is a source-data profile: it records the response exactly as the API returns it and does not filter, convert, or reinterpret any element.

## Structure

The response carries API metadata and a flat list of OSM elements:

- `version`, `generator`, `copyright`, `attribution`, `license` — API version, producing server software, and the copyright statement, attribution URL, and licence URL supplied by OSM.
- `bounds` — the requested bounding box (`minlat`, `minlon`, `maxlat`, `maxlon`) in WGS 84 decimal degrees.
- `elements` — nodes, ways, and relations in source order. Each element has `type`, `id`, `timestamp`, `version`, `changeset`, `user`, and `uid`, and optionally `tags`:
  - **nodes** carry `lat` and `lon`;
  - **ways** carry `nodes`, an ordered list of node identifiers (a closed way repeats its first node last);
  - **relations** carry `members`, an ordered list of `{type, ref, role}` references (the role may be empty).

Element identifiers are numeric and unique only within their element type, so a node and a way may share the same `id`. Geometry is implicit: ways and relations have no coordinates of their own, only references that resolve through the nodes in the same response. Tags are kept as an open key–value dictionary of uninterpreted source strings. In the JSON-LD context, each tag key maps to `https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:<key>`, following the [osm2rdf](https://github.com/ad-freiburg/osm2rdf) convention. For example, `plant:source` becomes `osmkey:plant:source`. Keys without a colon resolve through `@vocab`. Keys with a colon resolve through a prefix term for their first segment (`plant`, `seamark`, `name`, …), as JSON-LD 1.1 requires. Where that segment is also a bare key (`name`, `source`, `note`, …), the bare key expands to the prefix IRI with a trailing colon (`osmkey:name:`). The ontology declares those IRIs equivalent to the plain key IRIs. A tag key with a colon whose first segment has no prefix term in the context is read as an absolute IRI, so add that segment to the context when a new snapshot introduces one.

## Example snapshot

The request extent is `16.74361,54.953732,17.78045,55.13824`. The response contains 1,530 elements: 1,499 nodes, 17 ways, and 14 relations, with 413 distinct tag keys. Most nodes are untagged way vertices. Tagged features include 283 `power=generator` nodes (turbines), substations, submarine cables, and wind farm areas (`industrial=windfarm`, `power=plant`). The bounding box also returns features that are unrelated to wind energy, such as administrative boundaries, wrecks, and reefs. Element edit timestamps range from 2012-04-04 to 2026-10-18.

The snapshot reflects the OSM database at retrieval time. It is not a stable or authoritative national inventory. Any harmonisation, such as building GeoJSON geometries or selecting wind-farm features, belongs in a separate downstream transformation that keeps this raw response alongside its output. See the [OSM element model](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Elements) and the [OSM API map call](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/API_v0.6#Retrieving_map_data_by_bounding_box:_GET_/api/0.6/map).

## IHO semantics

IHO S-100 Data Dictionary item 42 is “Category of Offshore Production Area”, defined as the classification of an area at sea within which production facilities exist. Its listed value “Wind Farm” applies to wind-farm area features when source tags explicitly identify that category. The transform in the companion harmonised block asserts this IHO value only when the OSM tags identify a wind farm (`industrial=windfarm` or `seamark:landmark:production_area=wind_farm`). It does not assign the area category to individual turbine nodes or to ambiguous features. The IHO attribute is documented at the [IHO Geospatial Information Registry](https://registry.iho.int/fdd/view3.do?idx=42&type=3).

## Alignment and transformation to windfarm designated areas

`ontology.ttl` imports the SeaDOTs windfarm ontology (`owf:`, [common-windfarm-ontology](../common-windfarm-ontology/)) and declares, as data, how this source maps onto `owf:WindfarmArea` in [common-windfarm-designated-area](../common-windfarm-designated-area/):

- **Which elements are wind farms:** `osmdata:WindfarmElement`, defined as an OWL class (an element whose tag set has `plant:source=wind`, `industrial=windfarm` or `seamark:landmark:production_area=wind_farm`), with the same rules in machine-readable form (`osmdata:selectionRules`). A way that is an outer member of a wind farm relation, or has the same name as one, is part of that relation's wind farm.
- **How tags map onto properties:** `osmdata:windfarmTagMappings` is an ordered list of `osmdata:TagMapping` entries. Each one gives the target `owf:` property and its JSON key, the source tag keys in priority order, and either a conversion (`Copy`, `ParseInteger`, `ParseMegawatts`, `SplitSemicolon`, with a `CountGeneratorMembers` fallback) or ordered value rules. For example, `construction:power=plant` → `seadots-emodnet:Construction` and `power=plant` → `seadots-emodnet:Production`. Tag keys also carry `skos:closeMatch` / `skos:relatedMatch` links to the target properties.
- **Element-level rules**, documented in the ontology and applied by the transform: feature id from the element type and id, geometry and geodesic `area_sqkm` from the area way, `last_updated` from the latest edit of the merged elements, `source_reference` from the response bounds, `location_status`, and `same_as` for the merged ways.

`transforms.yaml` registers `to-windfarm-designated-area` (`transforms/osm_to_windfarm_area.py`). The transform loads the alignment from `ontology.ttl` and applies it, so editing a mapping there changes the output. On this block's example it reproduces the five OSM records of the designated-area example, geometry included. The only difference is the EMODnet `same_as` links, which cannot be derived from OSM. Country, installation type, distance to coast and EMODnet update year are not in OSM and stay null.

The transform is Python, not SPARQL. Walking the RDF lists of this snapshot (a 1,626-member relation, ways of up to 853 nodes) exceeds rdflib's recursion limit in property-path evaluation, and that would break a `sparql-construct` transform in the bblocks build.

## Licence

OSM data is licensed under the [Open Database License 1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). Keep the attribution "© OpenStreetMap contributors" ([copyright](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright)) when redistributing the example.

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: OpenStreetMap offshore wind snapshot
description: 'Unconverted OpenStreetMap API 0.6 JSON response (`/api/0.6/map` with
  a bounding box). The response carries API metadata, the request bounds, and a flat
  list of OSM elements: nodes with coordinates, ways with ordered node references,
  and relations with typed, role-labelled members. Tag keys and values remain uninterpreted
  source strings.'
type: object
required:
- version
- generator
- copyright
- attribution
- license
- bounds
- elements
properties:
  version:
    type: string
    description: OSM API version of the response.
    const: '0.6'
    x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#apiVersion
  generator:
    type: string
    description: Server software that produced the response.
    x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#generator
  copyright:
    type: string
    x-jsonld-id: http://purl.org/dc/terms/rights
  attribution:
    type: string
    format: uri
    x-jsonld-id: http://creativecommons.org/ns#attributionURL
    x-jsonld-type: '@id'
  license:
    type: string
    format: uri
    x-jsonld-id: http://purl.org/dc/terms/license
    x-jsonld-type: '@id'
  bounds:
    type: object
    description: Bounding box of the request, in WGS 84 decimal degrees.
    required:
    - minlat
    - minlon
    - maxlat
    - maxlon
    properties:
      minlat:
        $ref: '#/$defs/latitude'
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#minlat
        x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal
      minlon:
        $ref: '#/$defs/longitude'
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#minlon
        x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal
      maxlat:
        $ref: '#/$defs/latitude'
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#maxlat
        x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal
      maxlon:
        $ref: '#/$defs/longitude'
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#maxlon
        x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal
    additionalProperties: false
    x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#bounds
  elements:
    type: array
    description: OSM elements returned for the bounding box, in source order.
    items:
      oneOf:
      - $ref: '#/$defs/node'
      - $ref: '#/$defs/way'
      - $ref: '#/$defs/relation'
    x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#element
    x-jsonld-container: '@set'
    x-jsonld-extra-terms:
      node: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#Node
      way: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#Way
      relation: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#Relation
      id:
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#elementIdentifier
        x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer
      timestamp:
        x-jsonld-id: http://purl.org/dc/terms/modified
        x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime
      version:
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#elementVersion
        x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer
      changeset:
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#changeset
        x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer
      user: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#user
      uid:
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#uid
        x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer
      tags:
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#tagSet
        x-jsonld-context:
          '@version': 1.1
          osmkey: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:'
          '@vocab': 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:'
          ISO3166-1: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:ISO3166-1:'
          TMC: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:TMC:'
          alt_name: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:alt_name:'
          construction: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:construction:'
          contact: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:contact:'
          description: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:description:'
          generator: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:generator:'
          height: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:height:'
          long_name: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:long_name:'
          name: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:'
          note: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:note:'
          official_name: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:official_name:'
          old_name: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:old_name:'
          plant: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:plant:'
          population: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:population:'
          rotor: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:rotor:'
          seamark: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:seamark:'
          short_name: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:short_name:'
          source: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source:'
          teryt: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:teryt:'
          wreck: 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:wreck:'
additionalProperties: false
$defs:
  latitude:
    type: number
    minimum: -90
    maximum: 90
  longitude:
    type: number
    minimum: -180
    maximum: 180
  elementType:
    type: string
    enum:
    - node
    - way
    - relation
  elementId:
    type: integer
    minimum: 1
    description: Numeric identifier, unique only within its element type.
  elementCommon:
    type: object
    required:
    - type
    - id
    - timestamp
    - version
    - changeset
    - user
    - uid
    properties:
      type:
        $ref: '#/$defs/elementType'
        x-jsonld-id: '@type'
      id:
        $ref: '#/$defs/elementId'
      timestamp:
        type: string
        format: date-time
        description: Time of the last edit of this element version.
      version:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#apiVersion
      changeset:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
      user:
        type: string
        description: Display name of the last editor.
      uid:
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        description: Numeric identifier of the last editor.
      tags:
        type: object
        description: Unmodified key-value tags; keys and values are source-defined
          strings.
        minProperties: 1
        additionalProperties:
          type: string
  node:
    allOf:
    - $ref: '#/$defs/elementCommon'
    - type: object
      required:
      - lat
      - lon
      properties:
        type:
          const: node
          x-jsonld-id: '@type'
        lat:
          $ref: '#/$defs/latitude'
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#lat
          x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal
        lon:
          $ref: '#/$defs/longitude'
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#long
          x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal
    unevaluatedProperties: false
  way:
    allOf:
    - $ref: '#/$defs/elementCommon'
    - type: object
      required:
      - nodes
      properties:
        type:
          const: way
          x-jsonld-id: '@type'
        nodes:
          type: array
          description: Ordered node references; a closed way repeats its first node
            last.
          minItems: 2
          items:
            $ref: '#/$defs/elementId'
          x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#nodeReference
          x-jsonld-container: '@list'
          x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer
    unevaluatedProperties: false
  relation:
    allOf:
    - $ref: '#/$defs/elementCommon'
    - type: object
      required:
      - members
      properties:
        type:
          const: relation
          x-jsonld-id: '@type'
        members:
          type: array
          description: Member references in source order.
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - type
            - ref
            - role
            properties:
              type:
                $ref: '#/$defs/elementType'
                x-jsonld-id: '@type'
                x-jsonld-type: '@vocab'
              ref:
                $ref: '#/$defs/elementId'
                x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#memberReference
                x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer
              role:
                type: string
                description: Member role; may be empty.
                x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#memberRole
            additionalProperties: false
          x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#relationMember
          x-jsonld-container: '@list'
    unevaluatedProperties: false
x-jsonld-extra-terms:
  MapResponse: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#MapResponse
  Bounds: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#Bounds
  Element: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#Element
  TagSet: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#TagSet
  RelationMember: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#RelationMember
x-jsonld-prefixes:
  osmdata: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#
  dcterms: http://purl.org/dc/terms/
  cc: http://creativecommons.org/ns#
  xsd: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#
  geo: http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#
x-bblocks-metadata:
  itemIdentifier: ogc.hosted.seadots.windfarms.windfarm-openstreetmap
  register: https://ogcincubator.github.io/bblocks-seadots/build/register.json
  version: '0.1'
  dateOfLastChange: '2026-10-27'
